name: thegraph-panel
description: While /thegraph or /thegraph-herdr runs: a chip on path-band's line with the run's issue, step and time, which opens a pane with a gantt of the steps over the whole log as a table; the spinner and each turn's closing line carry the step and what the turn did. Inside Herdr a conductor's chip carries its workers, each a button that brings its tab to the front, and a worker's a button back to the conductor. Install path-band with it: the chip is drawn there.
